instruction: Crisp studio photograph, full shot from a high angle looking down at a minimalist white studio. On the left, the dancer in the black hooded outfit (R1) stands with legs apart and arms outstretched horizontally, looking toward their partner. On the right, the dancer in the white hooded outfit (R2) leans slightly with their right arm extended. R1's right hand touches R2's upper right arm in a balanced, fluid dance pose. Bright, even studio lighting casts soft, distinct shadows on the clean white floor.
